name: Bump Keys
description: A bump key is a specially cut key that, when struck while applying light rotational tension, momentarily bounces all pin stacks above the shear line simultaneously — opening the lock. Bump keys must match the target lock's keyway profile. The technique is fast and requires minimal skill but is audible and leaves visible marks on the keyway. Best used when speed outweighs stealth, or when the target environment's ambient noise floor makes the strike unremarkable.

blue.det: Audible impact sound; scratching on keyway; time at door without key use.
blue.cm: Bump-resistant cylinders (Medeco, Abloy, Mul-T-Lock) are immune; anti-bump security pins; access control logs for off-hours access.
